lines.text: Look at you. Same old shoes. Same old excuses.
I am working, boss. Every single day.
Working? Money is everything. Without money, nobody listens to you.
Money talks, true. But money never asks where you started.
Then tell me. Where did my money come from?
From a man who woke up early and refused to quit. I am that man now.
Your situation is not your destination. Get up. Work. Build.
